reviewScope: Short independent appraisal of coordinator-specified sources, not exhaustive systematic review

sources.title: Timeline-Bench: Evaluating Agents on Realistic Video-Editing Tasks, from Raw Footage to Final Cut
sources.coverage: arXiv abstract and metadata, not full text or reproduced evaluation
sources.supports: Artifact delivery, requirement satisfaction and editing quality are distinct outcomes in realistic editing tasks.
sources.limitations: No reproduction or grader audit; aggregate results do not predict Clicko or a particular current model's success.
sources.clickoImplication: Use technical and craft acceptance criteria separately, with human calibration.
sources.confidence: High provenance; limited appraisal and external applicability; no causal evidence for the proposed hybrid

sources.title: MotionBench: Benchmarking and Improving Fine-grained Video Motion Understanding for Vision Language Models
sources.supports: Fine-motion understanding remains difficult in evaluated VLMs; denser frame input helped tested systems.
sources.limitations: Not a test of Opus 5.5 in Clicko; no universal frame-sampling threshold established for this application.
sources.clickoImplication: Inspect temporal windows and test the evaluator on correct and defective controls.
sources.confidence: High provenance; limited directness for the current model and ad-editing task

sources.title: VBench: Comprehensive Benchmark Suite for Video Generative Models
sources.supports: Video generation evaluation can be decomposed into dimensions and checked against human judgments.
sources.limitations: Generating a clip is not equivalent to editing a persuasive ad; its aggregate scores do not certify copy, rhythm or CTA.
sources.clickoImplication: Keep motion, continuity, identity and message judgments separate.
sources.confidence: High provenance; indirect evidence for a local editorial rubric

sources.title: Our Motion Design & Animation Process
sources.version: Live page accessed 2026-11-13; publication date not supplied
sources.coverage: Full visible Message, Design, Animation and Audio sections
sources.supports: The studio describes preparing message/design/storyboards and considering audio throughout production.
sources.limitations: Self-reported and promotional; not an intervention study or universal workflow validation.
sources.clickoImplication: Prepare styleframes, animatic and a sound plan before expensive full-piece refinement.
sources.confidence: High provenance for this studio's stated process; low causal certainty of a quality gain in Clicko

sources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents
sources.coverage: Context relevance and anatomy of effective context, especially tool contracts and prompt specificity
sources.supports: Useful context and clear tools matter; vague instructions and brittle over-specification both create problems.
sources.limitations: No controlled evidence about Clicko creative quality or renderer choice.
sources.clickoImplication: Keep the director free while exposing relevant materials, references, state and capabilities efficiently.
sources.confidence: High traceability; engineering rationale, not a measured ad-quality effect

sources.title: Demystifying evals for AI agents
sources.coverage: Outcome versus trace, grader types, Descript example and calibration/rigidity guidance
sources.supports: Different graders serve different outcomes; model judgments require human calibration and rigid paths can penalize valid solutions.
sources.limitations: Vendor cases do not independently validate a particular Clicko rubric or quality improvement.
sources.clickoImplication: Separate deterministic checks, editorial assessment and human comprehension; grade the delivered artifact without prescribing a fixed edit path.
sources.confidence: High traceability; conditional application to local evaluation design
